newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen steady on Dow, deregulation.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen steady on Dow, deregulation.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to remain steady on Wednesday as Monday's economic deregulation package and a sharp rise on Wall Street overnight is seen keeping sentiment firm, brokers said.
"The Jakarta composite index hit a record high yesterday while the Dow also touched a record high overnight, there is no reason not to remain upbeat," one broker with a large local firm said.
Brokers said the latest economic deregulation package was likely to boost sentiment further as the package was seen as having a positive impact on the economy.
Stocks to watch include property and banking stocks after the government announced measures to limit loans to the property sector, brokers said.
On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index ended 2.83 points higher at 740.83 points.
